verdicts.criticalReason: The PR violates the requirement R1 from task-plan-redis-caching.json because it does not implement caching on the conversation messages endpoint (GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages) in InboxService. Furthermore, the custom FallbackCacheManager/FallbackCache implementation lacks a local in-memory fallback cache layer, leaving the database vulnerable to a cache stampede during any Redis connection outage.
concerns: Deletes critical integration tests (CampaignSystemPromptIntegrationTest.java, InboxControllerTest caching tests) and database migration files (V20260725182408117__add_custom_ai_system_prompts.sql) causing potential regressions and incompatibilities.

Lacks custom ObjectMapper polymorphic configuration registering PageSerializer and PageDeserializer for Spring Data Page and PageImpl, which results in type erasure and ClassCastExceptions during deserialization.
Removes existing caching annotations from InboxService completely, representing a severe regression in caching support compared to main.
Deletes rephrasing and personalization methods from LlmPersonalizationService and PersonalizationEngine, causing compilation and test failures across other components.
